observability.observation: Process creation with parent, image path, command line and signature
observability.note: Kernel process events; the signature is read from the file and the catalog.

observability.observation: File create, write, rename and directory removal
observability.note: File create/open is distinguished by the kernel's create disposition.
Measured: 26 live deletions produced zero file events. A deletion through the API is seen as a file event with the delete disposition, one made with `del` is not.

observability.observation: TCP connections and per-connection byte counts
observability.note: Kernel network events; the owning process comes from the kernel record.
UDP sends are not collected in this session; only TCP is attributed to a process.

observability.observation: DNS queries and their result status
observability.note: DNS client provider; status distinguishes a missing name from a resolver that could not be reached.
Manifest provider plus kernel open records joined by kernel object pointer.
Reads are sampled under volume pressure; the counter and any gaps are reported with the session.
The kernel provider in this session exposes no thread-injection keyword. A process attributed by location alone is the process-table footprint of cross-process creation, not proof of injection.

observability.observation: Payload content, URLs and decrypted traffic
observability.note: Only endpoints, sizes and timing are recorded.

observability.observation: Elevated processes started before the session began
observability.note: The scope tracker attributes children by kernel parent records and image path; a process whose parent chain was never observed is attributed by location.

observability.observation: Events produced while the agent was not running
observability.note: Argus is not a service: nothing is collected before the session starts or after it stops.
